content.short: Blockchain at Virginia Tech promotes student blockchain education.
content.description: Blockchain at Virginia Tech is a student-led organization dedicated to blockchain education and hands-on learning. It provides educational resources, hosts events and workshops, and connects Virginia Tech students with industry professionals. Students can use the group to learn about blockchain technology, develop blockchain-based applications, network with peers, and explore Web3 career opportunities across multiple networks.
